author: Vertyco
description: Texas Hold'em, slots, blackjack, craps and seven more casino games for ActivityHub, played inside Discord's Activity window in a Classic Vegas casino. Friends in the same voice channel share the tables, and every game still plays solo. At the Hold'em table players bet against each other, someone alone practices free against CPUs, and the casino's cut of each pot drains currency out of the economy. Slots grows a progressive jackpot from 2% of every bet while the house keeps about 5% of what's bet, so it works as a steady credit sink. Server admins tune each game's bets, payouts, cooldowns and access levels, design membership tiers, and hold big wins for review, from the casino's settings panel or with chat commands. Rebuilt for ActivityHub from Redjumpman's Casino: https://github.com/Redjumpman/Jumper-Plugins. Needs ActivityHub 0.13.0 or later.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs with each player's casino stats, cooldowns, membership tier and any winnings held for review, and the credits a player has at a Hold'em table.
install_msg:
Thank you for installing Vegas!

Vegas is a game for ActivityHub, which must be installed and set up first:
`[p]repo add vrt-cogs https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs`
`[p]cog install vrt-cogs activityhub`
`[p]load activityhub`
Then follow ActivityHub's README: https://github.com/vertyco/vrt-cogs/blob/main/activityhub/README.md

Once both are loaded, the casino shows up in the hub's menu, and `[p]vegas` posts a Play button. It can stay loaded next to Redjumpman's Casino: the names don't clash.

Rebuilt for ActivityHub from Redjumpman's Casino: https://github.com/Redjumpman/Jumper-Plugins
